profile.ja:
単独での危険な潜入任務を主とする手練の対魔忍。
才色兼備の女性で6ヶ国語に通じ、2つの博士号と数十に渡る分野の専門知識を有し、
あらゆる経歴の人物となって潜入可能という高度な隠密技術の持ち主。
戦闘能力も高く忍法木遁の術を使う。通称“花の静流”。
植物を操る力を持ち、特定の武器は持たず戦闘時は掌から強力な薔薇の鞭を出現させ操って戦う。
物腰軽やかな大人の女性。
神のいたずらにより、イマジナリー赤ちゃんを妊娠することになった静流。
お腹が大きく動きにくいため、潜入任務は当分の間お休みすることに。
仕事に生きてきた彼女だが、疑似妊娠を機に子育てに興味が出たらしく、
育児関係の本を購入する姿が確認されている。
profile.en: She is a seasoned Taimanin who specializes in dangerous solo infiltration missions. A talented and beautiful woman fluent in six languages, she holds two doctorates and possesses expert knowledge across dozens of fields, allowing her to assume any background and infiltrate with advanced stealth techniques. Her combat abilities are also high; she uses ninjutsu and wood-style techniques. Known as "Shizuru of the Flowers." She can manipulate plants and, without carrying weapons, summons a powerful rose-whip from her palm in battle. She carries herself with a light, adult grace. Due to a divine prank, she has become pregnant with an imaginary baby. Because her belly is large and movement is difficult, she will be taking a break from infiltration missions for the time being. Though she has lived for work, this pseudo-pregnancy has sparked an interest in child-rearing, and she has been seen purchasing parenting books.

text.ja: 身重ではあるけれど、足手纏いにならないわ。だからパパの格好いいところ、一番近くで見させてちょうだい♪
text.en: I'm pregnant, but I won't be a hindrance. So let me watch Papa's cool side up close♪

text.ja: イマジナリー赤ちゃんとはいえ妊婦になれるなんて、貴重な経験だわ。それも生徒の赤ちゃんなんてね
text.en: Even though it's an imaginary baby, getting to be pregnant is a precious experience. And it's the student's baby, too.

text.ja: 胸よりもお腹に視線が集まる感覚って新鮮ね。でも悪い気分じゃないわ。これが母親になるってことなのかしら
text.en: The feeling of everyone's eyes focusing on my belly rather than my chest is refreshing. But it's not a bad feeling. I wonder if this is what it means to become a mother.

text.ja: 産休中だからってサボりすぎは見逃せないわね。この子のパパになるんだから、しっかりしてもらわないと♪
text.en: Just because I'm on maternity leave doesn't mean I can slack off. Since you're going to be this child's dad, you need to step up♪

text.ja: バーは暫くお休みね……お酒にタバコに暴力、あそこはこの子の胎教に良くないものばかりだもの
text.en: I'll be taking a break from the bar for a while… alcohol, cigarettes, violence—none of that is good for the baby's prenatal education.

text.ja: この子の種があなたのものだってことは隠しておいた方がいいわね……私のお腹を見て、生徒が血の涙を流していたから
text.en: We should keep it hidden that this child's seed is yours… after all, I saw a student shedding blood-tears when they saw my belly.

text.ja: ふふっ、最近のあなたは増々凛々しくなってきたわね。父親としての自覚が芽生えてきた、ということかしら
text.en: Hehe, you've become more and more gallant lately. I guess that's your growing sense of responsibility as a father.

text.ja: ねえ、お腹を撫でてくれる？　そう……ふふっ、この子も喜んでるわ。ほぉら、これがパパのなでなででちゅよ～？
text.en: Hey, could you rub my belly? Yeah… hehe, this little one is happy too. See, this is Papa's gentle pat～?

text.ja: あんっ♪　妊婦に興奮してるの？　もう仕方ないわね……今だけ味わえる静流の妊婦オマンコで相手をしてあげる……♪
text.en: Ahh♪ Getting turned on by a pregnant woman? I guess there's no helping it… I'll treat you with Shizuru's pregnant pussy that you can only enjoy now♪

text.ja: んぁぁぁっ♪　あ、安定期に入ったからってこんないきなりぃ♪　お腹の子までスケベになっちゃ、んほぉぉぉ♪
text.en: Nnnaaa♪ Ah, just because I'm in the stable period and you're being so sudden… even the baby in my belly is getting lewd, nhoo…

text.ja: はぁ、んっ……♪　おっぱいもっと吸ってぇ♪　この子が産まれるまでは私のおっぱいミルク、全部あなたのものだからぁ♪
text.en: Haa, n…♪ More milk, please♪ Until this child is born, all my breast milk is yours…
